strong.notes: General reasoning model, good at coding and tool use.

strongest.notes: Strongest general reasoning model; use when review depth matters most.

workhorse.notes: Default for routine bounded work. Prefer this generous Codex allowance over comparable lightweight Copilot models.

alternative.notes: Strong independent perspective from another model family. Use selectively because it draws from the tighter Copilot allowance reserved primarily for scientific writing and review.

science.notes: Preferred specialist for consequential scientific writing and review. Reserve the tighter Copilot allowance for work that benefits from Claude's distinct strengths.

science-lite.notes: Lower-cost Claude specialist for bounded scientific writing and review. Prefer Luna for routine work so the tighter Copilot allowance remains available for Claude.
